profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company that describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility worldwide. According to its site, it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and now operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). Its core technology is called a "virtual driver," and the company says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations around the world.

The site states that Pony.ai's autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that this testing covered complex weather and road conditions. The company presents itself as an industry leader in commercializing autonomous driving and says it aims to deliver autonomous driving systems at scale.

Public records list Pony AI Inc. as a for-profit public company with ticker PONY and CIK 0001969302, headquartered in Guangzhou. No litigation, patent, or product registry entries are recorded for it.
